name: sensitivity_lane
comment: Paired probe on the lane channel. The road-border gate is graded (near/wide
scales above zero) while the lane channel's soft scales default to zero, so
a lane exit costs the policy nothing in the gradient even though the
evaluator counts it. This tests the graded penalty, not a hard gate: a gate
zeroes the reward outright and can silence the signal on whole scenes.
Mirror rb_near_scale for the on arm.
